turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting conveyor belt diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the initial inspection. Check the belt surface for cuts, gouges, or embedded debris. Examine the splice joint for separation or edge lifting, and inspect both pulley faces for grooving or material buildup.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the belt surface for cuts, gouges, or embedded debris. 2. Check the splice joint for separation or edge lifting. 3. Inspect both pulley faces for grooving or material buildup.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: initial inspecton complete belt surface looks good splice joint intact and both pulleys clean no grooving

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the belt surface for cuts, gouges, or embedded debris. 2. Check the splice joint for separation or edge lifting. 3. Inspect both pulley faces for grooving or material buildup.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Based on your assessment, is there any splice failure or deep cuts in the belt?

ground_truth.node_text: Belt damage assessment, splice failure or deep cuts?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no belt in good condition no splice failure or deep cuts

ground_truth.node_text: Belt damage assessment, splice failure or deep cuts?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the belt tracking within plus or minus 5 millimetres of centreline?

ground_truth.node_text: Belt tracking within ±5 mm of centreline?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no belt drifitng off centre more than 5mm

ground_truth.node_text: Belt tracking within ±5 mm of centreline?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the belt tracking using the tail roller tilt in half turn increments.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust tracking via tail roller tilt, half turn increments

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: tail roller adjustment complete made two hlaf turns

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust tracking via tail roller tilt, half turn increments

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the belt tracking after the tail roller adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify belt tracking after tail roller adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah belt still drifting off centre tracking hasnt improved enough

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify belt tracking after tail roller adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform the secondary belt tracking correction. Slacken the tail roller locking bolts and adjust the roller end opposite to the drift direction in 2 millimetre increments. Run the belt for two minutes between each adjustment to allow stabilisation, and check frame squareness with a precision square.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary belt tracking correction: slacken the tail roller locking bolts and adjust the roller end that is opposite to the direction of belt drift in 2 millimetre increments. Run the belt for two minutes between each adjustment to allow the tracking response to stabilise. Check frame squareness with a precision square before returning to the belt tracking observation step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: secondary correction complete made three 2mm adjustemnts with stabilisation runs frame squareness confirmed

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary belt tracking correction: slacken the tail roller locking bolts and adjust the roller end that is opposite to the direction of belt drift in 2 millimetre increments. Run the belt for two minutes between each adjustment to allow the tracking response to stabilise. Check frame squareness with a precision square before returning to the belt tracking observation step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the belt tracking now.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify belt tracking after tail roller adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: ok so tracking acceptable now belt running within tolerance

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify belt tracking after tail roller adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the belt tension within the specified deflection range?

ground_truth.node_text: Belt tension within specified deflection range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no deflection measurement outside allowable range belt too loose

ground_truth.node_text: Belt tension within specified deflection range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the take up tensioner to correct the belt deflection.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust take up tensioner to correct belt deflection

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: take up tensioner adjusted belt tension increased

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust take up tensioner to correct belt deflection

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the belt tension after the take up adjustment.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: tension correct now deflection within spec range

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify belt tension after take up adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do all idler rollers rotate freely with no flat spots?

ground_truth.node_text: All idler rollers rotate freely with no flat spots?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes all idler rollers spinning smoothly no binding or flat spots detected

ground_truth.node_text: All idler rollers rotate freely with no flat spots?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drive motor temperature within the rated limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Drive motor temperature within rated limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah both end cap temps well below max rated limit on nameplate

ground_truth.node_text: Drive motor temperature within rated limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drive chain elongation within the wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Drive chain elongation within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no chain elongation exceeded wear limit replacment needed

ground_truth.node_text: Drive chain elongation within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the drive chain and retension it to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace drive chain and retension to specification

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: drive chain replaced and retensioned to spec

ground_truth.node_text: Replace drive chain and retension to specification

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Jog the conveyor slowly until a reference part reaches the end of line sensor. Measure the trigger point distance from the part leading edge to the sensor face with a steel rule and compare it against the setpoint distance on the sensor setup drawing.

ground_truth.node_text: Jog the conveyor slowly until a reference part reaches the end of line sensor and observe the sensor indicator light. Measure the distance from the part leading edge to the sensor face at the trigger point using a steel rule. Compare against the setpoint distance specified on the sensor setup drawing and adjust the bracket position if the trigger point is outside tolerance.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: sensor trigger point measured and compared to setup drawing

ground_truth.node_text: Jog the conveyor slowly until a reference part reaches the end of line sensor and observe the sensor indicator light. Compare against the setpoint distance specified on the sensor setup drawing and adjust the bracket position if the trigger point is outside tolerance.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the end of line sensor trigger point within plus or minus 2 millimetre tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no trigger point outside tolerance by about 3mm

ground_truth.node_text: End of line sensor trigger point within ±2 mm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reposition the sensor bracket and reteach the trigger point.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: sensor bracket repositioned trigger point retaught successfully

ground_truth.node_text: Reposition sensor bracket and reteach trigger point
